evidence.evidence_text: We introduce COSMIC, a practical implementation of this metric, and demonstrate its strong correlation with human judgment-based metrics, as well as its effectiveness in predicting downstream task performance.
Comparative analyses against established metrics like BERTScore and ROUGE highlight the competitive performance of COSMIC.
